gloss: on the strong side; slightly dark/rich

definitions.gloss: on the strong/dark/rich side; somewhat concentrated
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is slightly stronger, darker, or richer than standard — typically flavor, color, or makeup. The suffix {目|め} indicates 'leaning toward' or 'on the ... side.'

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃|こ}い{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like my coffee on the strong side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濃|こ}い{目|め}にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make the seasoning a bit stronger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃|こ}い{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to go out with slightly heavier makeup today.

notes: The suffix め (目) means 'somewhat' or 'on the ... side' and normally follows the adjective stem: ⟦{薄|うす}め→薄め：29057_usume⟧ (on the light/thin side), {甘|あま}め (on the sweet side), ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧ (on the large side). Because the stem {濃|こ} is a single syllable, the full form ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧ + め is used (rarely {濃|こ}め). Usually written {濃|こ}いめ, with め in kana. Commonly used when ordering food or drinks to specify preference. Opposite: ⟦{薄|うす}め→薄め：29057_usume⟧ (on the weak/light side).
